flags.text: Chemical splash in the eye: irrigate immediately with water for at least 15-20 minutes
Penetrating eye injury: shield the eye, no pressure, emergency ophthalmology
Swollen red lid with fever or painful eye movement: possible orbital cellulitis, urgent
Drooping lid with large pupil and headache: possible aneurysm, emergency
White pupil reflex in a child: possible retinoblastoma, urgent referral
Eye discharge in a newborn: urgent assessment
Curtain over vision or new flashes and floaters: possible retinal detachment, urgent
